maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly new recreational powerboat sales (MasterCraft, Crest, Balise, Chaparral, Robalo) to first-time or replacement consumers, not servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Boats are sold through dealers to private consumers; government is not the final payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from building and selling boats; the Crest, Balise and Chaparral/Robalo additions are occasional deals, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Discretionary recreational boats; buyers can easily choose other boat brands, with no operational dependence or regulatory lock-in.

notes: The website now shows MasterCraft Boat Holdings as owning Chaparral and Robalo, so the company appears to have combined with MasterCraft. I answered for the combined boat maker.
